verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for a hosted search API, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents retention policies, deletion requests, zero-retention options, or user-controllable data lifecycle settings. The items cover search features, integrations, Goggles, SafeSearch, date filters and pricing, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
